description: Out-of-fold assignment behind every calibration figure reported for the eRepo-primary surface. Index i refers to the i-th variant of the missense pathogenic/benign set, in the order bench/track1b_erepo_headtohead.load_rows yields them; variant_index below gives the key for each.
